title: ds-map
description: The crosswalk: each design-system component joined across the served code manifest and the Figma library, with its coverage state, its token references, and a CANDIDATE atomic-design level. Lane A (figma-library-census) emits; Lanes B, F, I read (plan-sheerline-fdde-loop-2026-09-07 section 3.3). Version 1.0; additive thereafter. rows[] is the binding section 3.3 shape. Every level is a candidate: level_confirmed is false on emission and only a human sets it true at the crosswalk-review gate.

provenance.description: Additive. Where and when the crosswalk ran, and the true coverage counts.

code_component.description: The code-manifest component name; null for a figma-only row.

figma_key.description: The Figma component/set key; null for a code-only row.

figma_name.description: Additive. The Figma component name, for readability on figma-only rows; null when not applicable.

token_refs.description: Token names this component references, from the served manifest's token map.

coverage.description: both: present and consistent in code and Figma. code-only: in the manifest, no Figma component. figma-only: a Figma component with no manifest entry. divergent: present in both but a mechanically detected disagreement (a token binding or property axis differs) that a human adjudicates at the gate.

level.description: CANDIDATE atomic-design level. Derived from Figma composition (nested library-component instances), refined by the served graph's contains_component where the manifest encodes containment, and by cross-surface recurrence. An INSTANCE_SWAP of a leaf/icon component does not promote an atom.

level_confirmed.description: Human sign-off at the crosswalk-review gate. Always false on emission.
